name: Administrative Counties 18 Apr 1899
description: The administrative counties and county boroughs created by the Local Government (Ireland) Act 1898, as declared by the Local Government Board's order of 1 Nov 1898 under section 68 and in effect from 18 Apr 1899: 33 administrative counties (Tipperary in two ridings) and the county boroughs of Dublin, Belfast, Cork, Limerick, Londonderry and Waterford. Built from the reconstructed 1901 DEDs, each placed in the administrative county printed in Table VI of the 1901 county volumes, with the Dublin Corporation Act 1900 put back. Where the county volumes print a legible total area, the map agrees with it within 0.5%.

references.label: Census of Ireland 1901 and 1911, county volumes, Table I head-notes
references.note: The Local Government Board order of 1 Nov 1898 under s.68 of the 1898 Act, and each administrative county's composition.

references.label: Local Government Board for Ireland, Twenty-seventh Report (C.9480, 1900), pp. 235-330: orders declaring the boundaries of administrative counties
references.note: Effective date 18 Apr 1899, as cited by Wikipedia's article on the Local Government (Ireland) Act 1898; the report itself not yet seen.

references.label: Census of Ireland 1901, county volumes, Table VI
references.note: The administrative county of each DED.

references.label: OSNI County Series six-inch (1:10,560), County Down sheet 4, Edition 5 (revised 1931)
references.note: Shows the county borough boundary ("Co. Boro. Bdy.") in a straight line from the Inner Lighthouse at the tip of the East Twin to a boundary post on the railway at Tillysburn; Edition 3 (1902) and Edition 4 (1920-21) show the same line. The pre-1958 Belfast line in the lough east of the lighthouse is traced from this sheet. Viewed in PRONI's Historical Maps Viewer (OSNI).

references.label: OSNI County Series six-inch (1:10,560), County Antrim sheet 57, Edition 5 (revised 1931)
references.note: Shows the county borough boundary ("Co. Boro. Bdy.") in a straight line from the Antrim shore south of Greencastle to the Inner Lighthouse; Editions 3 and 4 (1901-02) show the same line. The pre-1958 Belfast line in the lough west of the lighthouse is traced from this sheet. Viewed in PRONI's Historical Maps Viewer (OSNI).
